title: Arcis Blood Extraction and PCR Setup
author: Opentrons
materials: Corning 360µL Plate, clean and empty Slot
Bioplastics Plate (in holder), clean and empty Slot
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Open the Opentrons protocol designer and input all required parameters for the Arcis Blood Kit run (e.g., sample and reagent volumes, deck layout).

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Generate and download the Python protocol file from the designer.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons App, upload the downloaded protocol file.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck exactly as described:

substeps.instruction: Slot 1: Opentrons tiprack (compatible with P50‑Single and P300‑Single).
Slot 2: Corning 96‑well plate, 360 µL flat, clean and empty.
Slot 3: Bioplastics 8‑tube strip mat (100 µL plate) in holder, clean and empty.
Slot 4: Second Bioplastics 8‑tube strip mat (100 µL plate) in holder, clean and empty.
Slot 5: Opentrons 24‑tube rack with 1.5 mL Eppendorf Safe‑Lock tubes – A1 contains Sample (1000 µL), A2 contains PCR Mastermix (1500 µL).
Slot 6: Opentrons 10‑tube rack with conical tubes – A1 contains Reagent 2 (2000 µL), A3 left empty.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate the tiprack, all placed labware, and both the P50‑Single and P300‑Single pipettes. Follow the app’s calibration workflow and consult the support articles for tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the Opentrons App to start the Arcis Blood Extraction and PCR setup on the robot.
